subject: Next steps: procurement path & payment method (Aurelia Systems pilot)
messages:
From: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@aurelia.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rieck <tom.rieck@aurelia.com>, procurement@aurelia.com
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding questionnaire and payment preferences

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the team liked the latency numbers and the idea of a short pilot. Procurement asked me to share our vendor onboarding questionnaire and clarify payment preferences up front so we can route this correctly. Attached is our standard questionnaire (PDF).

Quick answers from our side:
- For contracts > $25k/year we typically require a formal PO and vendor setup in Coupa.
- For pilots under $10k we can pay by corporate card (one-time payment) to expedite things.
- Marketplace purchases (e.g., AWS Marketplace) are preferred by Platform/Cloud Ops because they avoid an AP vendor setup. If you have a marketplace listing or can provide a marketplace-style invoice, that helps.

Also, procurement asked to confirm: SOC 2 Type II report, DPA, and data retention policy (how long logs are kept). If you can point me to those docs or attach what you have, we can move faster.

I attached the questionnaire. I'll coordinate internally but wanted to capture this as our starting point.

Best,
Lisa Grant
Procurement Manager
Aurelia Systems

--
Attachment: Aurelia_vendor_questionnaire.pdf (application/pdf, 234 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@aurelia.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 20:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding questionnaire and payment preferences

Hi Lisa — appreciate the clear summary and the questionnaire. Attaching our standard quote and a short checklist that maps to the items you asked for. TL;DR on the procurement points you called out:

- PO vs card: We can accept a one-time card payment for pilots <= $10k. For annual agreements > $25k we expect a PO/contract path.
- Marketplace: We are listed on the Azure Marketplace (invoice-as-a-service available) and can provide a marketplace invoice for quick provisioning; AWS Marketplace listing is in progress (ETA Q2).
- Compliance docs: SOC 2 Type II and our DPA are available; I linked the SOC2 and attached the quote that includes the DPA link.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Marcus — can you confirm whether we can accept Aurelia's procurement questionnaire as-is or if Finance needs extra fields populated?
2) Karthik — please prepare the technical appendix for the questionnaire (KV cache retention, logging retention window, and regional controls).
3) Lisa — if Marketplace is preferred, would you like a Marketplace invoice option first to avoid the Coupa vendor setup? If not, who should we expect as the Coupa/vendor contact for Aurelia?

I'll hold off on sending final quote until Marcus confirms billing route — want to avoid rework.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0133

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding questionnaire and payment preferences

Marissa / Marcus — quick internal follow-ups after reviewing Lisa's questionnaire and Marissa's note.

Procurement gating items we need to close before sending an enterprise PO-friendly quote:
- SOC 2 Type II: confirm latest report date (we should provide the 2025 report).
- DPA & Data Flow: confirm retention windows and whether logs exported to customer-managed storage is required.
- Invoice delivery: Aurelia's Coupa flow likely requires an invoice XML/EDI or a punchout. If they want Coupa vendor setup, billing will need remit-to details + W9.

Marketplace path questions:
- If Aurelia buys via Azure Marketplace, revenue recognition is different but it removes Coupa setup friction. We should include Marketplace price as an alternate SKU on the quote. Marcus — can you confirm whether a Marketplace invoice will accept our standard SKU line items (same pricing tier)?

Action items:
- Marcus: confirm accounting for Marketplace vs PO (fees, recognition) and whether we can accept a pilot on card and then move to PO for annual renewal without migration work.
- Marissa: ask Lisa for the Coupa/vendor contact (name + email) if they choose PO path. Also confirm whether AP needs vendor tax docs up front or only at PO issuance.

I'll draft the technical appendix for the questionnaire (will include caching/kv TTLs, retention, and region controls) by Monday EOD.

Karthik
Head of Solutions 
Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@aurelia.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Tom Rieck <tom.rieck@aurelia.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding questionnaire and payment preferences

Hi Lisa — looping back with the internal next steps and a couple of clarifying questions so we can pick the smoothest commercial path.

Summary of options we can support today:
- Fastest path: Azure Marketplace invoice for the pilot (no Coupa vendor setup). We can provision within 24 hours once purchase is complete.
- Pilot by card: Aurelia pays up to $10k by corporate card; we'll treat that as a one-time payment and convert to PO for annual renewal if you choose to continue.
- Full PO/vendor setup: Coupa vendor setup for contracts > $25k/year. This route requires typical vendor paperwork (W9, remit-to) and usually takes 7–14 business days to onboard.

From procurement notes: if you prefer PO, please share the Coupa contact or the person who issues vendor invites; otherwise, we can send the Marketplace invoice link.

Attached: updated quote with a Marketplace SKU line and a short tech appendix draft from Karthik (first pass). Marcus — can you confirm accounting implications for Marketplace vs PO by EOD today so I can give Aurelia a single recommended path?

Lisa — also attaching the SOC 2 link and our DPA for your records (SOC2 link included in the quote URL).

Proposed next meeting: 30-minute sync with Procurement + Cloud Ops + us to decide the route and timeline. Are you available Wed 3/11 at 10am PT?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
